import java.util.*;
public class heidiLearnsHashingCodeforce {
	
	public static void main(String[] args) {
		// TODO Auto-generated method stub
		Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
		long r = sc.nextLong();
		sc.close();
		long arr[] = result(r);
		if(arr[0] == 0) {
			System.out.println("NO");
		}
		else System.out.println(arr[0] + " " + arr[1]);
	}
	static long[] result(long r) {
		long arr[] = new long[2];
		long i,y;
		long sqrt = (long)Math.floor(Math.pow(r,0.5));
		for(i=1; i<=sqrt; i++) {
			if((r-(i*i + 1 + i))%(2*i) == 0 && (r-(i*i + 1 + i)) > 0) {
				y = (r-(i*i + 1 + i))/(2*i);
				arr[0] = i;
				arr[1] = y;
				return arr;
			}
		}
		return arr;
	}
}
